reason: The report gives the unadjusted OLS coefficient (2.23) as the effect of supplier diversification, but supplier_diversity is correlated with pre-period firm traits (log sales r≈0.31, years exporting, 2020 export growth). Adding the pre-treatment controls cuts the estimate to about 0.61 (SE 0.23), so the headline size is overstated roughly 3-4x by confounding. The report also never checks this, and it trims the outcome without saying why.
